subject: Materials Science
title: Titanium: Strong, Light, and Expensive
description: A quick win: understand Titanium: Strong, Light, and Expensive.

hook.text: A titanium hip implant can stay inside a human body for 30 years with no rejection.

buildup.text: Titanium is as strong as steel but 45% lighter, and it resists body fluids perfectly.

discovery.text: Its oxide layer is so stable that the body treats it as bone rather than foreign metal.

twist.text: Extracting titanium requires vacuum furnaces — that's why it costs ten times more than steel.

climax.text: Fighter jets and spacecraft use titanium where nothing else can survive the stress.

punchline.text: Titanium is the metal the body and sky both trust.

quiz.question: Why is titanium biocompatible?
options: It dissolves slowly in body fluids
Its oxide layer makes the body treat it like bone
It is coated with plastic before implanting
